notes: A CASTLE IN THE ARCADE: a fifth cabinet joins the Bug Mall Arcade - CASTLE, a tribute to Castle Adventure (1984). Twenty rooms, 13 treasures, 15 monsters: find the sword in the Armory, the gate key in the Dungeon, and escape for up to 1550 points. Plus a trimmed title-screen header, a 40 px/s speed floor for heavy hats, and a thicker frown on the Android icon spider.
